headline: Shipping company CEO admits to using Strait of Hormuz corridor primarily as high-speed shortcut to deliver late-night biryani
body: The regional logistics director confirmed that the new transit agreement will focus exclusively on maintaining sub-45 minute delivery windows for oceanic spice shipments, effectively prioritizing chicken dum biryani over standard petroleum exports. Maritime radar logs indicate that several container ships have already been observed making unauthorized detours specifically to drop off cooling raita at mid-sea refueling stations.
